design.endpoint: measured original zone row count versus min(n, max(0, max_forward_dr)), and measured rotated zone whole-board status versus max_forward_dr <= 0 (owner 0) / min_forward_dr >= 0 (owner 1)

instrument_correction.first_run: crashed with TypeError because RayAtom.max_steps is None (unbounded) for every ray in this generator
instrument_correction.fix: unbounded rays are capped at n-1 rank steps, the maximum attainable on the board; pre-written predictors unchanged
instrument_correction.second_change: added a post-hoc predictor that uses the smallest positive rank advance instead of the largest, because the plan_a5 derivation conflates maximum reach with band width; it is reported separately and is not the pre-registered test

post_hoc_minstep.label: post-hoc corrected predictor, not the pre-registered one

nonclaims: no search and no strength, utility or outcome claim
the explanation is about zone geometry only
